solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: A copper-lined box made carefully and precisely

indicators.note: a box lined with something has that material running inside its walls, so the copper goes within

parts.note: a crate is a wooden box
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A craftsman fashions a copper-lined box with great care.
explanation.definitionFit: Work that is exact and free from error has been done with care and precision.

clue.text: Where you may find the sailor on the way

definitions.text: Where you may find the sailor on the way

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on top of the next, so the sailor comes first

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is the usual crossword sailor
a road is a way

explanation.surface: Wondering where a seaman might be when he is travelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors are typically overseas, in foreign lands, which is what the word describes.

clue.text: Company representative certain about nothing, but shows aplomb

indicators.note: here certain comes round, after, the nothing in the order of the pieces

parts.note: an MP, Member of Parliament, is an elected representative
O, the figure zero, is nothing
certain means sure

explanation.surface: A firm's spokesman, sure of nothing, still manages to look self-assured.
explanation.definitionFit: Aplomb is calm self-possession, a synonym for cool steadiness under pressure.

clue.text: Cherry and almond pie made by a writer

indicators.note: printer's pie is a jumble of spilled type, so these letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A baker's cherry and almond pie, apparently created by an author.
explanation.definitionFit: The American crime novelist who created the detective Philip Marlowe is a famous example of a writer.

clue.text: One who volunteers to fight, but he's not a boxer

definitions.meaning: a member of the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force, is nicknamed so
a breed of dog other than the boxer, playfully denied being one

explanation.surface: A volunteer soldier who fights but is not a prizefighter.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is slang for a Territorial Army reservist and also names a small hunting dog breed, unlike the boxer breed.

clue.text: Hole made by a tracer?

indicators.note: the letters of the word tracer are made into something new, rearranged

explanation.surface: Asking whether a tracer bullet blasted a hole in the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowl-shaped hole blown in the ground by an explosion or impact.

clue.text: Knight to bring up topic for discussion

definitions.meaning: to knight someone is to elevate a subject of the Crown to a higher rank
to introduce a matter into conversation

explanation.surface: A knight being asked to introduce a matter for debate.
explanation.definitionFit: Read literally, it means elevating one of the monarch's people, as dubbing does; idiomatically it means introducing a topic.

clue.text: Carried infant — little Edward

parts.note: a tot is a small child
Ed is the short form of Edward

explanation.surface: A baby, young Edward, was carried about.
explanation.definitionFit: To tote something is to carry it, so the past tense means carried.

clue.text: Music game on the seashore

parts.note: rock is a style of music
pool is a cue game played on a table

explanation.surface: Music and games enjoyed at the beach.
explanation.definitionFit: A pool of seawater left among rocks when the tide goes out is found by the seashore.

clue.text: This insect makes a chap sit up

parts.note: a chap is a man

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word sit is read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: An insect startling a man into sitting upright.
explanation.definitionFit: The praying variety is a well-known predatory insect with folded forelegs.

clue.text: An odd card game

definitions.meaning: old British slang for strange or peculiar
a card game of melding sets and runs

explanation.surface: A strange game of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: It is dated British slang for peculiar, and also a popular card game of collecting sets.

clue.text: Recital is a composition that's unsentimental

indicators.note: a composition puts things together in a new arrangement, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A music recital described as a hard-headed piece of work.
explanation.definitionFit: Being practical and down-to-earth means taking an unsentimental view of things.

clue.text: Advocate appearing as a famous explorer gains essential point

indicators.note: gains means the explorer acquires the next piece added after him

parts.note: Marco Polo, the Venetian traveller to China
the gist is the essential point

explanation.surface: A defender likened to a noted traveller who grasps the crux.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who argues in defence of a cause or belief is its advocate.

clue.text: Finish on your head, maybe

definitions.meaning: to finally arrive somewhere, to wind up
the wrong way round, standing on one's head with feet in the air

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to finish up somewhere; read literally it describes being upside down, as when standing on one's head.

clue.text: Killing the return of revolutionary spirit

indicators.note: a return goes back the way it came, so these letters are read backwards

parts.note: a red is a revolutionary communist
rum is a spirit

explanation.surface: A killing marks the comeback of a radical drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the return of' turns REDRUM backwards (Red Rum was also a famous racehorse).
explanation.definitionFit: Homicide, the unlawful killing of a person.

clue.text: Half the school get zero, unusual for music

indicators.note: the first half of the word school, three of its six letters
unusual means the letters of zero are set in an odd order

explanation.surface: Half the pupils score nothing, which is rare in music class.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Half' takes SCH; 'unusual' makes ERZO from ZERO.
explanation.definitionFit: A lively, playful movement in a symphony or sonata is a piece of music.

clue.text: Check again about the test in English

parts.note: re means about or concerning
an exam is a test

explanation.surface: Going over an English test a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect or scrutinise something once more is to check it again.

clue.text: Satisfied when sausage mash is set before a number

indicators.note: the mashed letters are placed ahead of the number
mash means the letters of sausage are crushed up and rearranged

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500

explanation.surface: Hunger satisfied when bangers and mash arrive before a crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mash' makes ASSUAGE from SAUSAGE; 'sausage and mash' is a classic British pub meal.
explanation.definitionFit: To relieve or appease a hunger or desire is to satisfy it.

clue.text: Observes the intrusion and is furious

indicators.note: an intrusion pushes in, so the word the goes inside

parts.note: observes means sees

explanation.surface: Someone notices an intruder and flies into a rage.
explanation.definitionFit: To boil with rage, an idiom of liquid bubbling over, means to be furious.

clue.text: Short-lived supporter

definitions.meaning: a moment, an instant that passes quickly
an assistant to a duellist or boxer, someone who backs a motion

explanation.definitionFit: It names a brief instant of time and also a boxer's or duellist's attendant who backs them up.

clue.text: Realised that the bounder has embraced the girl

indicators.note: embracing means the bounder's letters wrap around the girl

parts.note: a cad is a bounder, an ungentlemanly man
she stands for any girl

explanation.surface: Something dawned once the rogue hugged the young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Converting an asset or cheque into money is to realise it, a financial sense.

clue.text: Ordered select eastern instrument

indicators.note: ordered means the letters of select are arranged afresh

explanation.surface: A choice instrument from the East was ordered.
explanation.definitionFit: A keyboard instrument striking metal plates, heard in Tchaikovsky's Sugar Plum Fairy.

clue.text: Withdraw from the general uprising

indicators.note: uprising says the hidden letters are read backwards
the clue word that says the letters sit inside the next words

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Pulling out of a popular revolt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' marks the hidden letters EGENER in 'the general'; 'uprising' reads them bottom to top in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To go back on a promise or undertaking is to withdraw from it.

clue.text: City game to back embargo

indicators.note: to back means the letters of the game go backwards

parts.note: RU is rugby union
an embargo is a ban

explanation.surface: A city sport that supports a trade embargo.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes things belonging to a city or town.

clue.text: Those on the other leg?

parts.note: morris dancers wear jingling pads on both shins; the rhyme says, rings on her fingers and these on her toes

explanation.definitionFit: Morris dancers strap jingling ringers to their shins, so one leg's set and the other leg's set are a pair.

clue.text: Take the car, beetle off and whoop it up

indicators.note: off means the letters of the car and the beetle go wrong, scrambled

explanation.surface: Driving off in the car, the beetle gone, and partying.
explanation.definitionFit: To whoop it up is an idiom for partying noisily, to have a festive time.

clue.text: Connections to a course for drivers?

definitions.text: Connections to a course for drivers?

parts.words: Connections to a course for drivers?
parts.note: links are connections; a driver is also a club for the longest shots on a sporting course

explanation.definitionFit: A seaside course for playing the club-and-ball game, where drivers are the long-hitting clubs, not motorists.

clue.text: The very best from France

parts.note: the select few, a word borrowed from French and still spelt with an accent there

explanation.definitionFit: A select top group, the cream; the word comes straight from French, meaning chosen.

clue.text: Walk out on the sands

definitions.meaning: an arid, sandy region such as the Sahara

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to abandon; as a noun it is a dry sandy wasteland.

clue.text: He has good taste to eat these when cooked

indicators.note: cooked means the letters of the words are prepared differently, rearranged

explanation.surface: A gourmet relishes eating these once prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: A connoisseur who appreciates beauty and art is said to have refined taste.
